notes: Amounts are integer USD cents. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC.
This file is a demo contract document. ledger_response is the response payload; requests are internal service examples, not new HTTP routes.
This implementation format replaces the earlier single-entry example. entry_id is local; provider_invoice_id is a separate PayPal identifier. Never translate a caller's status into payment proof.
Route names come from TEAM_WORKPLAN.md; approval route remains Member 4's decision.
Human identity comes from authenticated server context, never the request body.
The approved payer_reference is an opaque server-resolved reference, not an email.
Only the current VERIFIED_PAID state contributes to recovered_cash.
Provider status may be null if no valid status was returned; it is not proof of payment.
provider_invoice_id and invoice_url are null until available; verified_at is null unless currently verified.
Retries after ambiguous outbound writes may return PAYMENT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Do not change the key.
